verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח וַיֹּ֧סֶף אִשָּׁ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yiq·qaḥ way·yō·sep̄ ’iš·šāh ū·šə·māh qə·ṭū·rāh
verses.literal: Now Abraham had taken another wife named Keturah

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־ זִמְרָן֙ וְאֶת־ יָקְשָׁ֔ן וְאֶת־ מְדָ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֶת־ יִשְׁבָּ֖ק וְאֶת־ שֽׁוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ lōw ’eṯ- zim·rān wə·’eṯ- yā·qə·šān wə·’eṯ- mə·ḏān wə·’eṯ- miḏ·yān wə·’eṯ- yiš·bāq wə·’eṯ- šū·aḥ
verses.literal: and she bore him Zimran - Jokshan - Medan - Midian - Ishbak - and Shuah

verses.original: וְיָקְשָׁ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־ שְׁבָ֖א וְאֶת־ דְּדָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י דְדָ֔ן הָי֛וּ אַשּׁוּרִ֥ם וּלְטוּשִׁ֖ים וּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·qə·šān yā·laḏ ’eṯ- šə·ḇā wə·’eṯ- də·ḏān ū·ḇə·nê ḏə·ḏān hā·yū ’aš·šū·rim ū·lə·ṭū·šîm ū·lə·’um·mîm
verses.literal: Jokshan was the father of - Sheba - and Dedan And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites the Letushites and the Leummites

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנֹ֔ךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê miḏ·yān ‘ê·p̄āh wā·‘ê·p̄er wa·ḥă·nōḵ wa·’ă·ḇî·ḏā‘ wə·’el·dā·‘āh kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê qə·ṭū·rāh
verses.literal: The sons of Midian were Ephah Epher Hanoch Abida and Eldaah All these were descendants of Keturah

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶת־ וַיִּתֵּ֧ן כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- way·yit·tên kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw lə·yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: Abraham - left everything - he owned to Isaac

verses.original: בְּעוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חַ֔י לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם נָתַ֥ן מַתָּנֹ֑ת וְלִבְנֵ֤י אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם הַפִּֽילַגְשִׁים֙ וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֞ם מֵעַ֨ל בְּנוֹ֙ יִצְחָ֤ק קֵ֖דְמָה אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḥay lə·’aḇ·rā·hām nā·ṯan mat·tā·nōṯ wə·liḇ·nê ’ă·šer ’aḇ·rā·hām hap·pî·laḡ·šîm way·šal·lə·ḥêm mê·‘al bə·nōw yiṣ·ḥāq qê·ḏə·māh ’el- ’e·reṣ qe·ḏem
verses.literal: But while he was still alive Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his . . . concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac - to the land of the east

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ חָ֑י חַיֵּ֥י וְאֵ֗לֶּה יְמֵ֛י שְׁנֵֽי־ מְאַ֥ת וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃ שָׁנָ֛ה
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer- ḥāy ḥay·yê wə·’êl·leh yə·mê šə·nê- mə·’aṯ wə·šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Abraham - - lived a total of . . . . . . 175 . . . . . . . . . . . . years

verses.original: טוֹבָ֖ה בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה וַיִּגְוַ֨ע וַיָּ֧מָת אַבְרָהָ֛ם זָקֵ֣ן וְשָׂבֵ֑עַ וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·w·ḇāh bə·śê·ḇāh way·yiḡ·wa‘ way·yā·māṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām zā·qên wə·śā·ḇê·a‘ way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw
verses.literal: And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died . . . old and contented and was gathered to his people

verses.original: בָּנָ֔יו יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃ אֶל־ שְׂדֵ֞ה עֶפְרֹ֤ן בֶּן־ צֹ֙חַר֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר
verses.transliteration: bā·nāw yiṣ·ḥāq wə·yiš·mā·‘êl way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- mə·‘ā·raṯ ham·maḵ·pê·lāh ‘al- pə·nê mam·rê ’el- śə·ḏêh ‘ep̄·rōn ben- ṣō·ḥar ha·ḥit·tî ’ă·šer
verses.literal: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near . . . Mamre in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite -

verses.original: הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם מֵאֵ֣ת קָנָ֥ה בְּנֵי־ חֵ֑ת אַבְרָהָ֖ם קֻבַּ֥ר שָׁ֛מָּה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃ וְשָׂרָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer- ’aḇ·rā·hām mê·’êṯ qā·nāh bə·nê- ḥêṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām qub·bar šām·māh ’iš·tōw wə·śā·rāh
verses.literal: This was the field that Abraham . . . had bought from the Hittites . . . Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם מ֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ בְּנ֑וֹ יִצְחָ֣ק יִצְחָ֔ק וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב עִם־ בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·rā·hām mō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- way·ḇā·reḵ bə·nōw yiṣ·ḥāq yiṣ·ḥāq way·yê·šeḇ ‘im- bə·’êr la·ḥay rō·’î
verses.literal: - After Abraham’s death God - blessed his son Isaac who lived near vvv vvv Beer-lahai-roi

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ת אַבְרָהָ֑ם בֶּן־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית שָׂרָ֖ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת יָלְדָ֜ה לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·lə·ḏōṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām ben- yiš·mā·‘êl ’ă·šer hā·ḡār ham·miṣ·rîṯ śā·rāh šip̄·ḥaṯ yā·lə·ḏāh lə·’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael whom Hagar the Egyptian Sarah’s maidservant bore to Abraham

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל בִּשְׁמֹתָ֖ם לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֑ם נְבָיֹ֔ת בְּכֹ֤ר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê yiš·mā·‘êl biš·mō·ṯām lə·ṯō·wl·ḏō·ṯām nə·ḇā·yōṯ bə·ḵōr yiš·mā·‘êl wə·qê·ḏār wə·’aḏ·bə·’êl ū·miḇ·śām
verses.literal: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael vvv in the order of their birth Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael then Kedar Adbeel Mibsam

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמָ֥ע וְדוּמָ֖ה וּמַשָּֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·mā‘ wə·ḏū·māh ū·maś·śā
verses.literal: Mishma Dumah Massa

verses.original: חֲדַ֣ד וְתֵימָ֔א יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḏaḏ wə·ṯê·mā yə·ṭūr nā·p̄îš wā·qê·ḏə·māh
verses.literal: Hadad Tema Jetur Naphish and Kedemah

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְטִֽירֹתָ֑ם שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: êl·leh hêm bə·nê yiš·mā·‘êl wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·ṯām bə·ḥaṣ·rê·hem ū·ḇə·ṭî·rō·ṯām šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār nə·śî·’im lə·’um·mō·ṯām
verses.literal: These were the sons of Ishmael and these were their names by their villages and encampments twelve . . . princes of their tribes

verses.original: יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל חַיֵּ֣י וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ מְאַ֥ת וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים שָׁנָ֛ה וַיִּגְוַ֣ע וַיָּ֔מָת וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·mā·‘êl ḥay·yê wə·’êl·leh šə·nê mə·’aṯ ū·šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh wə·še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm šā·nāh way·yiḡ·wa‘ way·yā·māṯ way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw
verses.literal: Ishmael lived a total of . . . 137 . . . . . . . . . . . . years Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֵֽחֲוִילָ֜ה עַד־ שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָה נָפָֽל׃פ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ אֶחָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kə·nū mê·ḥă·wî·lāh ‘aḏ- šūr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê miṣ·ra·yim bō·’ă·ḵāh ’aš·šū·rāh nā·p̄āl ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl ’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: [Ishmael’s descendants] settled from Havilah to Shur which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַבְרָהָ֑ם בֶּן־ יִצְחָ֖ק אַבְרָהָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām ben- yiṣ·ḥāq ’aḇ·rā·hām hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: This is the account of Abraham’s son Isaac Abraham became the father of - Isaac

verses.original: יִצְחָק֙ וַיְהִ֤י אַרְבָּעִ֣ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֔ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֶת־ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י מִפַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲח֛וֹת לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq way·hî ’ar·bā·‘îm ben- šā·nāh bə·qaḥ·tōw ’eṯ- lōw lə·’iš·šāh riḇ·qāh baṯ- bə·ṯū·’êl hā·’ă·ram·mî mip·pad·dan ’ă·rām ’ă·ḥō·wṯ lā·ḇān hā·’ă·ram·mî
verses.literal: and Isaac was forty years old . . . when he married - Rebekah the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean vvv from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean

verses.original: יִצְחָ֤ק וַיֶּעְתַּ֨ר לַֽיהוָה֙ לְנֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י הִ֑וא עֲקָרָ֖ה יְהוָ֔ה וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃ רִבְקָ֥ה וַתַּ֖הַר
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq way·ye‘·tar Yah·weh lə·nō·ḵaḥ ’iš·tōw kî hî ‘ă·qā·rāh Yah·weh way·yê·‘ā·ṯer lōw ’iš·tōw riḇ·qāh wat·ta·har
verses.literal: Later, Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife because she [was] barren And the LORD heard his prayer and his wife Rebekah conceived

verses.original: הַבָּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ וַיִּתְרֹֽצֲצ֤וּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־ כֵּ֔ן לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·nîm bə·qir·bāh way·yiṯ·rō·ṣă·ṣū wat·tō·mer ’im- kên lām·māh zeh ’ā·nō·ḵî wat·tê·leḵ liḏ·rōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But the children inside her struggled with each other and she said . . . . . . Why is this happening to me So [Rebekah] went to inquire - of the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה לָ֗הּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁנֵ֤י גֹיִים בְּבִטְנֵ֔ךְ וּשְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִמֵּעַ֖יִךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּלְאֹם֙ יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ מִלְאֹ֣ם וְרַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lāh way·yō·mer šə·nê ḡō·yīm bə·ḇiṭ·nêḵ ū·šə·nê lə·’um·mîm mim·mê·‘a·yiḵ yip·pā·rê·ḏū ū·lə·’ōm ye·’ĕ·māṣ mil·’ōm wə·raḇ ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ṣā·‘îr
verses.literal: and [He] declared to her Two nations are in your womb and two peoples from within you will be separated one people will be stronger than the other and the older will serve the younger

verses.original: יָמֶ֖יהָ וַיִּמְלְא֥וּ לָלֶ֑דֶת וְהִנֵּ֥ה תוֹמִ֖ם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·me·hā way·yim·lə·’ū lā·le·ḏeṯ wə·hin·nêh ṯō·w·mim bə·ḇiṭ·nāh
verses.literal: When her time came to give birth there were indeed twins in her womb

verses.original: הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ וַיֵּצֵ֤א אַדְמוֹנִ֔י כֻּלּ֖וֹ שֵׂעָ֑ר כְּאַדֶּ֣רֶת וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·wn way·yê·ṣê ’aḏ·mō·w·nî kul·lōw śê·‘ār kə·’ad·de·reṯ way·yiq·rə·’ū šə·mōw ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: The first one came out red . . . covered with hair like a fur coat so they named him . . . Esau

verses.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֞ן אָחִ֗יו יָצָ֣א אֹחֶ֙זֶת֙ עֵשָׂ֔ו בַּעֲקֵ֣ב וְיָד֤וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיִצְחָ֛ק שִׁשִּׁ֥ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֖ה בְּלֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên ’ā·ḥîw yā·ṣā ’ō·ḥe·zeṯ ‘ê·śāw ba·‘ă·qêḇ wə·yā·ḏōw way·yiq·rā šə·mōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiṣ·ḥāq šiš·šîm ben- šā·nāh bə·le·ḏeṯ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: After this his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel - so he was named . . . Jacob And Isaac was sixty years old . . . when [the twins] were born -

verses.original: הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַֽיִּגְדְּלוּ֙ עֵשָׂ֗ו וַיְהִ֣י יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֛ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְיַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·‘ā·rîm way·yiḡ·də·lū ‘ê·śāw way·hî yō·ḏê·a‘ ṣa·yiḏ ’îš śā·ḏeh wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’îš tām ’îš yō·šêḇ ’ō·hā·lîm
verses.literal: When the boys grew up Esau became a skillful hunter a man of the field while Jacob . . . was a quiet man who stayed at home

verses.original: כִּי־ יִצְחָ֛ק בְּפִ֑יו צַ֣יִד אֶת־ וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב עֵשָׂ֖ו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yiṣ·ḥāq bə·p̄îw ṣa·yiḏ ’eṯ- way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ ‘ê·śāw wə·riḇ·qāh ’ō·he·ḇeṯ ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Because Isaac had a taste for wild game - he loved Esau but Rebekah loved - Jacob

verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיָּ֥זֶד נָזִ֑יד עֵשָׂ֛ו וַיָּבֹ֥א מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְה֥וּא עָיֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yā·zeḏ nā·zîḏ ‘ê·śāw way·yā·ḇō min- haś·śā·ḏeh wə·hū ‘ā·yêp̄
verses.literal: One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew Esau came in from the field and was famished

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֜ו וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־ הַזֶּ֔ה הָאָדֹ֤ם הָאָדֹם֙ כִּ֥י אָנֹ֑כִי עָיֵ֖ף עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·śāw way·yō·mer ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ hal·‘î·ṭê·nî nā min- haz·zeh hā·’ā·ḏōm hā·’ā·ḏōm kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ā·yêp̄ ‘al- kên qā·rā- šə·mōw ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: He said to Jacob Let me eat . . . some of that red [stew] for I am famished That is why . . . he was also called . . . Edom

verses.original: כַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־ מִכְרָ֥ה לִֽי׃ בְּכֹֽרָתְךָ֖ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֹּ֖אמֶר
verses.transliteration: ḵay·yō·wm ’eṯ- miḵ·rāh lî bə·ḵō·rā·ṯə·ḵā ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yō·mer
verses.literal: First - sell me your birthright Jacob replied

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו אָנֹכִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לָמ֑וּת וְלָמָּה־ זֶּ֥ה בְּכֹרָֽה׃ לִ֖י
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh way·yō·mer ‘ê·śāw ’ā·nō·ḵî hō·w·lêḵ lā·mūṯ wə·lām·māh- zeh bə·ḵō·rāh lî
verses.literal: Look said Esau I am about to die . . . so what good . . . is a birthright to me

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ כַּיּ֔וֹם יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַיֹּ֣אמֶר וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ וַיִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת־ לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃ בְּכֹרָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·ḇə·‘āh lî kay·yō·wm ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yō·mer way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lōw way·yim·kōr ’eṯ- lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·ḵō·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Swear to me first - Jacob said So [Esau] swore to [Jacob] and sold - him the birthright

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לֶ֚חֶם עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וּנְזִ֣יד לְעֵשָׂ֗ו וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־ וַיִּ֥בֶז הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ nā·ṯan le·ḥem ‘ă·ḏā·šîm ū·nə·zîḏ lə·‘ê·śāw way·yō·ḵal way·yê·šət way·yā·qām way·yê·laḵ ‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- way·yi·ḇez hab·bə·ḵō·rāh
verses.literal: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau [who] ate and drank and then got up and went away Thus Esau - despised his birthright
